title: But in terms of modeling better practice in open source communities for the students we teach let's not broadcast conflict, rather deal with it in ope
summary: But in terms of modeling better practice in open source communities for the students we teach let's not broadcast conflict, rather deal with it in open channels, our CoC has methods you can use, but please do not call out someone's employer on Twitter. It isn't nice.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: But in terms of modeling better practice in open source communities for the students we teach let's not broadcast conflict, rather deal with it in open channels, our CoC has methods you can use, but please do not call out someone's employer on Twitter. It isn't nice.
